newsitem.title: USA: Energy Search West Va. success continues.
newsitem.headline: Energy Search West Va. success continues.

text.p: Energy Search Inc said Tuesday it has successfully drilled the fifth and sixth wells on the Beaver project in Raleigh county of southern West Virginia where up to 150 wells are expected to be developed over the next three years.

The average estimated ultimate recoverable reserves per well is 492 million cubic feet, 64 percent higher than the company's 325 million cubic feet targeted average. It said this is resulting in a to-date finding cost of $0.36 per thousand cubic feet as compared to the company's financial target of $0.65-$0.70.
The company said its favorable locale enables it to sell natural gas to the northeast market at a premium above the NYMEX spot price. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
